reason: Office fountain water is fine for me and I've got a Brita at home, so a filter isn't solving anything I actually notice. I'd spend $60 on a bottle that looks great on my desk, but nothing here tells me this one does, and a filter subscription on top makes it feel like a chore.
objection: I'd be paying almost $68 up front and signing up for filters I don't really need, for a bottle I haven't seen look better than the one I already carry.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in nice colorways that clearly look better than my current bottle, sold on its own with free shipping and no plan attached.
